verdicts.reason: A keeps the quote's order, hierarchy and centred stack intact, but it is just the portrait panel dropped in the middle: the dark overlay ends in hard vertical edges and the brighter background shows at both sides, so it reads as pillarboxed rather than redesigned. B scrambles the quote (SCIENCE, then Albert Einstein, then RELIGION, then the two lines swapped), so it no longer makes sense. It also puts a stray empty dark rectangle on the left and sets the text over a busy, bright starfield.
